purpose: Test fixed portfolio construction mechanisms motivated by the descriptive Q090 finding of substantial common market exposure across the five unchanged Q069 sleeves.

parent_diagnostic.interpretation: Q090 is descriptive. Its output is not used to rank or select Q091 variants.

variants.rule: At every decision date, average the five frozen Q069 target-weight vectors using identical 1/5 sleeve weights.

At every decision date, demean each frozen Q069 target-weight vector across the full fresh evaluation universe, average the five residual vectors with identical 1/5 sleeve weights, then gross-normalize to exactly unit gross exposure when nonzero.
variants.exposure_contract: zero net exposure and unit gross exposure when active

data_contract.coverage_selection_rule: Only fixed data-coverage validity may determine the eight-symbol batch; no performance metric is available at selection time.

sequence: freeze Q091 rules and source contracts
run PIT/mutation tests for the portfolio transformation
evaluate both fixed variants symmetrically with unchanged 13 gates
reconcile result immutably into the trial ledger
